left.raw_text: Subject must have a diagnosis of COPD

right.raw_text: based on the American Thoracic Society (ATS)/ European Respiratory Society (ERS) criteria.

left.raw_text: Females must be of Non Child Bearing Potential

right.raw_text: The definition of Non Child Bearing Potential is as following: Females, regardless of their age, with functioning ovaries and who have a current documented tubal ligation or hysterectomy, or females who are post-menopausal.

left.raw_text: Have diagnosed COPD stage III or IV

right.raw_text: according to GOLD criteria: a baseline post-bronchodilator Forced Expiratory Volume, measured at 1 second (FEV1) <50% of predicted normal and a baseline post- bronchodilator FEV1/Inspiratory Vital Capacity (IVC) ratio <70%

left.raw_text: Have experienced at least 2 moderate or severe COPD exacerbations leading to medical consultation

right.raw_text: (requiring oral corticosteroids or increasing dosage of oral corticosteroids and/or antibiotics or hospitalization) within the 12 months preceding Visit 1.

left.raw_text: Have stable COPD medication within 4 weeks prior to Visit 1
Current or ex-smokers with a smoking history of at least 10 pack years

right.raw_text: (number of pack years = [number of cigarettes per day / 20] x number of years smoked, e.g., 20 cigarettes per day for 10 years, or 10 cigarettes per day for 20 years).
